notes: Names printed: RIDDLE R'D (60'), PROBASCO (NOT IMPROVED) 50', CLIFTON AV. (100'), with 'OPPOSITE BURNET WOODS PARK' printed in Clifton's east half. Only Clifton's west building line is drawn (x~5822 at the top, ~5918 at Riddle, ~5925 at Probasco); its east side is the park and is not drawn. The Clifton centre is taken 50 ft (~310 px at this sheet's ~6.15 px/ft, measured from Riddle 60' = 372 px and Probasco 50' = 305 px) east of the west line, i.e. x~6228; the 6in water pipe at x~6105-6115 is not on the centre. Riddle and Probasco both come in from the left edge and end at Clifton (T). Clifton has no other cross streets on this sheet. The Clifton Golf Club house drive, the tennis court, the 'Golf Links' boundaries and the ravine bed crossing block 3 are not streets; the dashed diagonal across block 2 is not a street.
